github.description: GitHub MCP server for repository operations — used by Pronghorn to discover org structure, list repos, and manage repository settings via the GitHub API.

pronghorn_generate.description: Generate a complete application project from natural language requirements. Creates a new repository in the sandbox organization with generated code, branch protection, and security scanning enabled.

appName.description: Name for the application and repository (kebab-case recommended)

requirements.description: Natural language description of the application requirements

pronghorn_status.description: Check the status of the Pronghorn service, including sandbox org configuration and token availability.
